title: FemTheme Solo #016 · 여 블랙 글래머·CarnivalGlam·메이드 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit stretch of the Great Wall of China with worn brick paving, waist-high crenellated parapet, standard-height arched gate and stone steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Brazilian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, sun-bronzed glowing skin, gold and copper shimmer eyes, a glossy nude-coral lip, soft rose-gold hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a lead barrel-shaped weight, a gold small flared temple bell, a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a copper ship's anchor, a bronze chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long rose-gold chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop with a heavy rough silver a ship's anchor hanging at its end, and two to three gold bracelets. Extremely long oval nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a white ruffled lace maid headband, a black lace choker with a small bow and white lace wrist cuffs, a micro strapless black satin bandeau reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and covering only what it must, and a minimal black satin micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
SUBJECT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme gold platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
